judge.rationale: The candidate makes the exact same one-line runtime change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference and adds appropriate tests and spec line-number updates. However, the candidate completely missed updating `CHANGELOG.md`, which was explicitly required by the acceptance criteria (and even listed as an unchecked item in its own `.lore/dod.md`). Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate replaced the bullet point in place under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (leaving the header 'This issue changes none of them' contradictory) rather than moving the new guarantee into the active specification section as the reference did. Finally, the candidate left behind an extraneous acceptance test file and `.lore/dod.md` artifact.
